scope: Certified native policyc compilation on bb2; complete public corpus hashed and scanned on Mac; new tuple signed by the existing demo key; final route-bound record proof passed in the pinned-nightly real-served harness on bb2. compiler.implementation: Lean policyc: cached derivatives + certified union + checked reachability trim + exact factor successor optimization

stark_validation.scope: Actual served assembly prover/verifier in a standalone harness against the normal circuit library, using the final certified table, route-bound descriptor and public record fixture. This is not a full-crate bootstrap verdict.
stark_validation.negative_checks: Changed final state, route root, public length, and explicit record under the same proof/public inputs refused.

table_file_sha256.input: Complete absence-table.json file bytes, including all metadata, duplicated row/flat layouts and final newline.
table_file_sha256.serialization: scripts/benchmarks/policy-compile.py --table-output writes json.dumps(parsed_native_stdout, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n'. This identifies the exported file, not an independently retained raw native stdout stream.

table_layout_sha256.input: UTF-8 JSON projection to num_states, transitions, start, accepting; json.dumps(projection, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); no final newline.
table_layout_sha256.scope: Preserves state numbering and array order; this is a serialized table-layout digest, not a language-equivalence canonical form.

default_replay_validation.scope: The full-crate Cargo bootstrap and unsplit run.sh replay command still need a passing verdict. Recorded evidence combines the native compiler benchmark, Mac generation/signature checks and real-served harness.
